heading: Document Corrections & Re-submission
subheading: Review official scrutiny remarks from BIS examiners, replace deficient or missing documents, and track re-submission review status in real time.

filter.searchPlaceholder: Search by document name, standard, or reason...

detailsDialog.title: Document Correction Details
detailsDialog.description: Comprehensive review findings and historical versions from the BIS scrutiny officer.
detailsDialog.historyEmpty: No prior versions recorded for this document.

wizard.dialogDescription: Complete the 5-step guided workflow to submit your rectified document to BIS examiners.

step1.title: Review Deficiencies & Requirements
step1.subtitle: Carefully examine the official reason for correction before selecting your replacement file.
step1.deadlineNotice: Please complete and submit the rectified document before the deadline to prevent application rejection.

step2.title: Select Replacement Document
step2.subtitle: Upload a new document from your device or select an existing document from your Compliance Vault.
step2.dropzoneHint: Drag and drop your PDF or DOCX file here, or click to browse (Max 15MB)
step2.vaultPrompt: Select a pre-indexed document from your organization's verified repository.

step3.title: Validation & Cortex Pre-scan
step3.subtitle: Verifying file integrity, format compliance, and pre-screening with Document Cortex.
step3.cortexAnalyzing: Analyzing document structure and clause coverage...
step3.cortexNote: Document Cortex performs automated structural checks. Official compliance determination rests solely with BIS officers.

step4.title: Review Re-submission Details
step4.subtitle: Confirm your replacement file and provide any optional explanatory remarks for the examiner.
step4.remarksPlaceholder: Describe the corrections made (e.g. added Clause 6.1 pressure test data tables on page 4)...
step4.declaration: I hereby declare that the replacement document submitted is authentic, accurate, and addresses all scrutiny feedback issued by BIS.
step4.declarationRequired: Please check the declaration box to proceed.

step5.title: Submitting to BIS Portal
step5.submittingText: Transmitting corrected document and metadata to BIS Scrutiny Gateway...
step5.doNotClose: Please do not close this window while the submission is processing.

success.title: Document Successfully Re-submitted
success.message: Your rectified document has been submitted to the BIS scrutiny queue. The examiner will review the update.

vault.dialogDescription: Choose a document previously uploaded and indexed in your Compliance Vault.
vault.empty: No matching documents found in Compliance Vault.

emptyState.title: No Document Corrections Required
emptyState.description: All submitted documents across your active applications are up to date and in good standing with BIS scrutiny.

errors.title: Unable to Load Document Corrections
errors.description: Failed to connect to the BIS Document Review Service. Please check your network connection and retry.
errors.uploadFailed: Failed to upload corrected file. Please verify format and size.
errors.submissionFailed: Failed to re-submit document. Server returned an error.
